description: This PHP source file defines the class ConfigHelper within the OrangeHRM project. It provides utility methods to interact with the configuration stored in the database, including retrieving, setting, and deleting configuration values related to the 'hs_hr_config' table.

classes.name: ConfigHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing configuration values stored in the database table 'hs_hr_config'. It allows fetching, updating, inserting, and deleting configuration entries, using Doctrine DBAL for database interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that optionally accepts a Doctrine DBAL Connection object for database operations.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the current database connection, creating a default one if none was provided.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Fetches the schema manager for database introspection, particularly to check table columns.

methods.name: getConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by its name, returning a default if not found.

methods.name: setConfigValue
methods.description: Sets or updates a configuration value in the database; inserts if it does not exist.

methods.name: deleteConfigValue
methods.description: Deletes a configuration value from the database.
